models_evaluated: LLaMA 3.1-8B with RAG (MedEmbed embeddings, Miller's Anesthesia retrieval source)

links.outcome: F1 for 30-day mortality and ASA class prediction with versus without RAG grounding
links.effect: Mortality F1 0.4663 with RAG and few-shot vs 0.0879 without RAG; ASA micro F1 0.8409 vs 0.6340 without RAG.
links.quote: The LLaMA-RAG model significantly improved the prediction of postoperative mortality and ASA classification, especially for rare high-risk cases.

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting to improve LLM prediction accuracy on clinical notes

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG grounding with a domain-specific textbook) and few-shot prompting compared to baseline LLM configurations for perioperative risk prediction on a retrospective clinical dataset.
